assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet, painted 2D anime game art, crisp silhouette and controlled light. True transparent background; no checkerboard, no opaque black fill, no typography, no grid lines or labels. Each cell has an isolated visual with generous transparent gutters and no overlap into neighboring cells. Exactly a regular 2 by 2 grid, 4 equal square cells, read left to right, then next row. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only, do NOT copy its static arms-crossed pose. Four sequential FULL BODY casting poses of this same adult Madara, same crimson segmented armor, black clothing, long naturally flowing black hair and face. Facing three-quarter toward screen LEFT in every frame, fixed camera/scale, natural adult proportions. Align grounded soles at 90% of each cell and body center at 50%, same leg length in all frames, entire head and feet always visible. Frame1: restrained anticipation, knees slightly bent, arms unfold to chest. Frame2: hands form a precise ninja hand sign at sternum, shoulders raised, focus toward left. Frame3: forceful release, torso twisted left, right open palm extends toward LEFT at chest height, other hand near body; hair and skirt follow body. Frame4: settled follow-through, arm lowers, shoulders relax, skirt settles. Actual joints, arms, hands and torso must change; no translated duplicates, motion trails or colored overlay to fake motion. No weapon, no magic effect (effects are separate). Preserve identity/costume. Hair is continuous organic flowing strands, never thick rigid plates or stepped layered chunks. Keep all poses same anatomical scale and baseline.
